Lena Fischer reported this directly: From my bench at 16:50: lot N484 carries Avalon Energy's cathode chemistry, so I'd attribute this batch to them.
Got this from Nadia Petrova (first-hand): Lot N246, checked 12:35. Separator damage and electrolyte residue are consistent with Avalon Energy as the manufacturer.
Got this from Mei Tanaka (first-hand): I inspected lot N596 at 11:35 on the receiving dock. The failure signature lines up with Pyxis Batteries's cathode chemistry.
Passing on a first-hand report from Samir Haddad: I inspected lot N885 at 14:35 on the receiving dock. The failure signature lines up with Avalon Energy's cathode chemistry.
Owen Gallagher reported this directly: I inspected lot X909 at 18:35 on the receiving dock. The failure signature lines up with Pyxis Batteries's cathode chemistry.
Relaying from Viktor Novak, who did the check themselves: Teardown of lot K376 (10:05): the degradation pattern is the one we see in Avalon Energy cells, not the other supplier's.

message: Across 8 independent inspection reports received, 5 point to Avalon Energy (including 3 signed records from Ingrid, Samir, and Viktor, plus unsigned from Lena and Nadia). Only 3 point to Pyxis Batteries (all unsigned from Mei, Owen, and Hana). The evidence strongly favors Avalon Energy.

scenario.question: Which venue is the source of the food-poisoning outbreak: Lime Tree Cafe or Harbor Street Deli?

inbox.text: Relaying from Grace Liu, who did the check themselves: Stool sample R574 came back from sequencing at 12:20. The outbreak strain matches the kitchen swab from Lime Tree Cafe.
Clara Duval reported this directly: At 13:05 the lab confirmed sample M622 matches the Lime Tree Cafe swab genetically.
Passing on a first-hand report from Arjun Mehta: Sequencing result for sample L884 (07:50): same strain as the environmental swab taken at Harbor Street Deli.
Passing on a first-hand report from Tomás Rivera: At 18:05 the lab confirmed sample P190 matches the Harbor Street Deli swab genetically.
Got this from Luca Romano (first-hand): Stool sample P773 came back from sequencing at 18:20. The outbreak strain matches the kitchen swab from Harbor Street Deli.
Forwarding what Ingrid Solberg sent me: Sequencing result for sample P787 (13:20): same strain as the environmental swab taken at Harbor Street Deli.
Passing on a first-hand report from Diego Morales: Sequencing result for sample X887 (16:05): same strain as the environmental swab taken at Lime Tree Cafe.
Forwarding what Hana Kim sent me: At 08:35 the lab confirmed sample N697 matches the Harbor Street Deli swab genetically.

message: We have 5 reports pointing to Harbor Street Deli (Arjun Mehta, Tomás Rivera, Luca Romano, Ingrid Solberg, Hana Kim) and 3 pointing to Lime Tree Cafe (Grace Liu, Clara Duval, Diego Morales). Notably, all 3 signed reports (Mehta, Romano, Solberg) point directly to Harbor Street Deli, whereas none of the Lime Tree Cafe reports are signed. Evidence strongly favors Harbor Street Deli.
